summary: Frontend-only regression for M671: verified mobile 2x2 loan partner grid, mobile single-row brand specs with per-logo height, project-specific lift brand (KONE vs Vasavi), desktop layouts, EMI page regression, and completed vs ongoing project CTA gating. All targeted assertions passed.

test_results.mobile_390_skylark_finance_2x2: PASS - icici/sbi on row1 (y=367), lic/idbi on row2 (y=467); no horizontal overflow; no white boxes (logos rendered on dark bg via transparent PNG).
test_results.mobile_390_skylark_specs_single_row_per_: PASS - all 8 base categories (paints, sanitary[3 logos], windows, lighting[2], cement[2], wiring, switches, tiles[text]) and lifts row render logos on a single row per category with labels above.
test_results.desktop_1920_skylark_finance_one_row: PASS - all 4 partners share y=522 (single horizontal row with names).
test_results.desktop_1920_skylark_specs_2col_label_le: PASS - label x=200, logo x=810 within spec row; sm:grid-cols-2 confirmed.
test_results.regression_emi_calculator_page: PASS - /emi-calculator loads with heading 'Plan your home loan, beautifully.' and 3 range sliders operational.
test_results.regression_completed_no_availability_cta: PASS - /projects/my-dream-skylark (completed) has 0 availability-enquiry-link and shows project-finance-emi-link (Calculate EMI) visible.

critical_code_review_comments: BrandSpecs.jsx uses `${b.h || 'h-6 md:h-7'}` in a className template — since Tailwind is JIT/PurgeCSS-based, the fallback string is safe (present as literal). Fine.
LoanPartners.jsx grid-cols-2 -> sm:flex breakpoint works for the 390px target; consider adding md tests if a 640-767 tab range matters, but not required for M671.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M671 mobile layouts (LoanPartners 2x2 + BrandSpecs single-row per category with h-prop-driven visual balance) verified on Skylark (kone) and Nest (vasavi). Availability CTA testid is 'availability-enquiry-link' — completed projects (like skylark) correctly hide it and expose 'project-finance-emi-link' Calculate EMI link instead. Use my-dream-aurelia (or any /^my-dream-(aurelia|elysium|aura|echelon|vale|ivy)$/) as an ongoing sample.
